ApprovalStatus.description: Approval state of a decision, criterion or constraint.
ApprovalStatus.title: ApprovalStatus

CriterionAssessment.description: Outcome of assessing one option (or the evidence) against one criterion.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence the verdict rests on, so the reader can check it.
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

limitations.description: Caveats on this verdict (thin evidence, cut-off retrieval) that the reader should weigh.
limitations.title: Limitations

option_id.description: The option assessed against the criterion; null when the evidence as a whole was assessed.
option_id.title: Option Id

outcome.description: Verdict for this pair: pass, fail, or uncertain when the evidence does not settle it.
outcome.title: Outcome

provider_answer.description: The raw provider distribution behind the verdict, kept for audit.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

CriterionAssessment.title: CriterionAssessment

ProviderAnswer.description: Raw provider distribution kept next to the derived outcome.

choice.description: The answer label the provider picked.
choice.title: Choice

confidence.description: The provider's own confidence in its answer (0 to 1), compared with the routing and decision thresholds.
confidence.title: Confidence

probabilities.description: The provider's probability for each answer label, kept so the derived outcome can be audited.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

ProviderAnswer.title: ProviderAnswer

Rationale.description: Concise explanation; origin labels who wrote it (never Jev hidden reasoning).

origin.description: Who wrote the text: a kernel template or the host, never the provider's hidden reasoning.
origin.title: Origin

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

text.description: The explanation of why the option was chosen, short enough to read in a report.
text.title: Text

Rationale.title: Rationale

TraceRefs.description: Where to inspect the run's trace and whether export is healthy.

observability.description: Whether trace export is healthy, so a missing trace can be told from a failed export.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

trace_id.description: Id of the run's trace in the observability backend, for looking it up.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

trace_url.description: Link to the run's trace, when the backend provides one.
trace_url.title: Trace Url

TraceRefs.title: TraceRefs

approval_status.description: Whether a human has approved the outcome, for decisions that require approval.

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that argues against the recommendation, kept visible rather than dropped.
contradicting_evidence_ids.title: Contradicting Evidence Ids

criterion_assessments.description: How options fared against each criterion, so the choice can be audited.
criterion_assessments.title: Criterion Assessments

limitations.description: Known weaknesses of the result (cut-off retrieval, missing sources) the reader should weigh.
limitations.title: Limitations

open_questions.description: What is still unanswered; an unresolved report lists what would settle it.
open_questions.title: Open Questions

rationale.description: Short explanation of why the option was chosen, with who wrote it.

recommendation.description: The plain-language answer to the question, shown to the caller when there is one.
recommendation.title: Recommendation

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

selected_option_id.description: Id of the option the decision picked; set only on a resolved report.
selected_option_id.title: Selected Option Id

status.description: Where the decision stands, so the caller knows whether to act, supply more, or wait for a human.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence that backs the recommendation, for the caller to inspect.
supporting_evidence_ids.title: Supporting Evidence Ids

trace_refs.description: Where to inspect this run's trace, for finding out how the result came about.
